summary: walk the room's state as one tree, each command's status and help beneath its name - n next, m more, b back, x runs the command the walk stands on, q quits; keys from the terminal, or as lines on stdin; each spot addressed by its JSON pointer

args.name: pointer
args.help: the spot to start on, as the walk says it in `at:` - a / before each key, ~1 for a slash within one; a space within a key may be typed bare; bare starts at the top. Where it names no spot the walk starts on the longest truncation of it that stands and exits 3; an argument that is no pointer is refused, exit 2; a command x ran that failed, exit 1
